messages:
maya: heads-up — Sentinel Labs just uploaded a SIG/CAIQ to the intake portal, asking for controls attestation and a quick POC-ready answers set. Can security own this and give an ETA by EOW? Link: https://redwood.example.com/portal/sentinel-sig-2026.pdf :eyes:
joni: I can take the first pass. Quick question — is this for Hosted or Dedicated? That changes BYOK/HSM answers.
maya: Hosted. They asked for data isolation options but said they'd accept tokenization instead of BYOK if needed. POC next Tue with solutions.
alex: noted — POC is Tue 10am. I'll own crypto/KMS Qs. @joni I'll DM the POC notes and sample prompts we used last month.
joni: thanks. Starting review now. Preliminary flags: need network segmentation evidence and an explicit incident response contact. Also will look for SOC2 artifact references.
nora: FYI sales asked for ETA to update the prospect. Can we commit to Thu COB for an initial answers pack?
joni: Thursday COB is doable for a draft. Final artifacts may need follow-up.
samir: if they push BYOK/HSM we'll need SRE to confirm supported HSM vendors and potential Dedicated uplift. Heads-up on pricing impact.
maya: understood. Please call out any items that would affect the commercial ask so I can loop AE & billing early.
forms-bot: New ticket created: SR-4821. Metadata: customer=Sentinel Labs, intake_type=SIG/CAIQ, priority=high, assigned=[joni, alex], due=2026-03-26.
billing-bot: Pricing note added to SR-4821: potential +15% uplift if BYOK/HSM required; escalation path created to Enterprise pricing team.
joni: quick excerpt of control question that needs evidence — copying here:
```
A.9.2: Describe network segmentation controls that limit lateral movement between tenant workloads.
```
joni: Requesting network diagrams + firewall rule summary (redacted) from customer or confirm we have an internal diagram that maps to controls.
alex: I'll prep the POC config note and include the minimal evidence we can provide for Hosted deployments (tokenization flow + prefix redaction).
maya: good. One more ask from buyer: can we confirm data retention windows for logs? That may be in SOC2 or a separate doc.
joni: noted. Adding to evidence list.
forms-bot: SR-4821 status updated -> "in-review" (assigned: joni, alex).
maya: thanks team — tagging @nora to keep prospect informed. I'll update the opportunity notes after the draft is ready. :thumbsup:
joni: will post the draft answers here when ready, then we can route for legal review if any custom T&Cs are requested.
alex: also flagging a minor gap on control for encrypted backups — will propose mitigation language for Hosted.
samir: if mitigation accepted, ops will document the exception and timeline.
maya: perfect. Ping me if anything blocks the Thu draft.
joni: starting now, ETA Thu COB.
maya: great — closing loop for now.
